25efca.title: NepalCasts architecture map
25efca.content:
Target: `/workspace/NepalCasts/NepalCasts`

- **Framework/runtime**: Vite + React 18 SPA (`src/main.tsx`) with `react-router-dom`, Clerk frontend auth, Firebase client SDK (Auth/Firestore/RTDB/Storage/Functions/Messaging/Analytics), Express 5 API in `server/src`, Firebase Cloud Functions in `functions/src`, Vercel serverless shims in `api/`.
- **Frontend entry/auth**: `src/main.tsx` wraps app in `ClerkProvider`, `BrowserRouter`, `HelmetProvider`, `LanguageProvider`. `src/providers/AppProviders.tsx` bridges Clerk session to Firebase via `signInWithCustomToken`, syncs Clerk profile into Firestore `users/{uid}` and `profiles/{uid}`, tracks `isAdmin`, and initializes OneSignal.
- **Frontend route surface**: public marketing/discovery/profile/casting/auth pages plus protected `/messages`, `/settings`, `/notifications`, `/saved`, `/calls`, `/applications`, and admin `/admin/*` under `src/routes/*.tsx` and `src/routes/routeConfig.tsx`.
- **Backend entrypoints**:
  - Express: `server/src/index.ts` mounts `/api` router with helmet, CORS, rate limiting, JSON parser, request ID, background Firestore listeners.
  - Firebase Functions: `functions/src/index.ts` exports callable handlers for profile, messaging, notification, casting, and admin actions.
  - Vercel: `vercel.json` rewrites `/api/:match*` to `api/proxy.js`, and exposes dedicated shims such as `api/admin-users.js`, `api/data-requests-approve.js`, `api/data-requests-reject.js`, `api/send-notification.js`.
- **Server route groups**:
  - `server/src/routes/profile.routes.ts`: `/public`, `/profile/public`, `/search`, `/profiles/:userId`, `/users/:uid/profile`, `/profile`
  - `server/src/routes/casting.routes.ts`: `/casting`, `/castings/:id`, `/discovery`, `POST /casting`, admin delete/priority routes
  - `server/src/routes/messaging.routes.ts`: conversation/message CRUD, reactions, pinning, read markers, block/unblock
  - `server/src/routes/upload.routes.ts`: `/config/cloudinary`, `/upload`, `/upload/avatar`, `/upload/casting/:castingId`, `/upload/media`, deletions
  - `server/src/routes/notification.routes.ts`: send/register-token/unread-count/mark-as-read
  - `server/src/routes/admin.routes.ts`: `/admin/users`, `/admin/log`, `/admin/settings`, role/ban/unban/delete actions
- **Auth/authz mechanisms**:
  - Frontend route gating is client-side (`ProtectedRoute`, `AdminRoute`) in `src/routes/routeConfig.tsx`.
  - Express auth uses Firebase ID token verification in `server/src/middleware/auth.ts`.
  - Admin auth is mainly `req.user?.admin === true`; some serverless shims also fall back to Firestore `users/{uid}.isAdmin` and may auto-set custom claims (`api/admin-users.js`).
  - Hardcoded super-admin email logic appears in `src/providers/AppProviders.tsx` and `functions/src/handlers/profile.ts`.
- **Data stores / primary collections**:
  - Firestore dominates: `users`, `profiles`, `casting_calls`, `conversations/{id}/messages`, `notifications`, `calls`, `applications`, `saved_calls`, `follows`, `reviews`, `reports`, `admin_logs`, `data_requests`, `deleted_users`, `securityRateLimits`, `securityEvents`, `one_time_tokens`, plus `users/{uid}/private/settings` and `users/{uid}/media`.
  - Realtime DB is initialized client-side (`src/lib/firebase.ts`) for call-related functionality.
  - Cloudinary stores uploaded media; OneSignal/FCM are used for notifications.
- **Background/integration behavior**:
  - `server/src/services/listeners.service.ts` watches Firestore `notifications`, `calls`, and `casting_calls` to send pushes / create matching notifications.
  - `server/src/config/cloudinary.ts` supports signed uploads when secrets exist, else unsigned uploads via preset fallback.
- **Security-relevant drift observed**:
  - `firestore.rules` and `storage.rules` currently allow `read, write: if true`, which conflicts with README claims and `server/src/tests/firestoreRules.test.ts` expectations.
  - Many admin and content-management frontend components still perform direct Firestore writes (not just backend calls), especially under `src/features/admin/*`.
  - `api/proxy.js` forwards arbitrary `/api/*` paths to `SERVER_URL` backend with copied headers/body.

**Priority follow-on hypotheses**
1. **Firestore/Storage authorization drift**: validate whether permissive deployed rules allow unauthorized direct client read/write across `users`, `profiles`, `reports`, `admin_logs`, `private`, media, or moderation data.
2. **Admin privilege surface split**: validate whether client-side admin screens plus fallback `users.isAdmin` checks permit privilege escalation or unauthorized admin actions when rules are permissive.
3. **Messaging/profile/casting BOLA**: validate ownership/participant checks across direct Firestore access and parallel Express/Functions implementations for `conversations`, `messages`, `profiles`, `casting_calls`.
4. **Upload path trust boundaries**: validate `upload.routes.ts` delete/update ownership checks, Cloudinary unsigned preset fallback, and any mismatch between metadata ownership and media records.
5. **Serverless shim consistency**: validate `api/admin-users.js`, data-request handlers, and `api/proxy.js` for auth/header/CORS consistency versus Express routes.
6. **Notification/token privacy**: validate exposure of `users/{uid}/private/settings`, FCM/OneSignal token handling, and notification mutation permissions.

29c97a.title: Repo architecture mapping methodology for NepalCasts
29c97a.content:
- Checked for scoped `AGENTS.md` files under `/workspace` up to depth 4; none were found covering `/workspace/NepalCasts/NepalCasts`.
- Used manifest + entrypoint review: `package.json`, `server/package.json`, `functions/package.json`, `README.md`, `src/main.tsx`, `src/App.tsx`, `server/src/index.ts`, `functions/src/index.ts`.
- Enumerated route surface with `rg` over `src/routes`, `server/src/routes`, and `functions/src/handlers`.
- Reviewed auth/authz and integration files: `src/providers/AppProviders.tsx`, `src/services/AuthService.ts`, `src/lib/firebase.ts`, `src/api/functionsClient.ts`, `server/src/middleware/auth.ts`, `server/src/config/index.ts`, `server/src/config/cloudinary.ts`, `server/src/middleware/uploadSecurity.ts`, `server/src/services/listeners.service.ts`, `api/admin-users.js`, `api/proxy.js`.
- Counted/triaged data-store usage via `rg` on `collection(` / `doc(` across `src`, `server/src`, and `functions/src`.
- Compared claimed security posture (`README.md`, tests) against active config (`firestore.rules`, `storage.rules`, `vercel.json`) to identify likely drift for follow-on validation agents.
- No exploit testing or live requests were performed in this task.
